gloss: to fly around, to flit about

definitions.explanation: For birds, insects, or aircraft to fly in various directions.

definitions.gloss: to rush about, to be busy going places
definitions.explanation: To move energetically from place to place (figurative use for people).

examples.japanese: {蝶|ちょう}が{花|はな}の{周|まわ}りを{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: Butterflies are flying around the flowers.

examples.japanese: {小鳥|ことり}が{木|き}から{木|き}へと{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: Small birds were flying from tree to tree.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると、トンボが{池|いけ}の{上|うえ}を{低|ひく}く{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る{姿|すがた}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: When summer comes, you can see dragonflies flying low over the pond.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{庭|にわ}を{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The children are running around the yard.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}で{世界中|せかいじゅう}を{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: I fly around the world for business.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{取材|しゅざい}のために{毎日|まいにち}あちこち{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っていて、{家|いえ}にいる{時間|じかん}がほとんどない。
examples.english: She rushes around from place to place every day for reporting, and has almost no time at home.

notes:
{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to fly around.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {飛|と}ぶ (to fly) + {回|まわ}る (to go around) → to fly around

ASPECT (ている):
{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている indicates an ongoing action of flying around.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空|そら}を{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around the sky)
- あちこち{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around everywhere)
- {世界|せかい}を{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る (fly around the world - often figurative for traveling extensively)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
When used for people, {飛|と}び{回|まわ}る typically means to travel frequently, often by airplane, usually for business purposes.

[Register: Neutral]
